name: Riot Grrrl · new finds
description: Candidate zines to complement the existing Riot Grrrl reading collection. Weekly searches cover direct movement references, established zine series, and related feminist/queer punk material. Every new item requires review.

baseline_source.meaning: Configured source identities, not a claim about current deployed catalog or publication permission.

searches.name: Riot Grrrl zines · direct references
searches.query: ("riot grrrl" OR "riot grrl") AND (zine OR zines)
searches.purpose: Find explicitly related zines; secondary literature and magazines can still match and require review.

searches.name: Known zine series · missing issues
searches.query: (title:"Girl Germs" OR title:VOOP OR title:"Violet Zine" OR title:"Bikini Kill" OR title:"No Apologies" OR title:"Personality Liberation Front" OR (title:Jigsaw AND creator:"Tobi Vail")) AND (zine OR zines)
searches.purpose: Watch for new issues/scans without treating generic titles as movement evidence.

searches.name: Adjacent scenes · feminist and queer punk
searches.query: ("feminist punk" OR "queer punk" OR Ladyfest) AND (zine OR zines)
searches.purpose: A companion discovery lane; association is not automatic classification as Riot Grrrl.

priority_candidates.title: I Love Jolie
priority_candidates.reason: Personal mini-zine signed Jolie Ego, with music fandom, handwritten lists and collage. Suitable for the historical personal-zine shelf; not a movement manifesto.
priority_candidates.evidence: PDF p.2 dates the issue 8-26-03 and explains the personal newsletter; p.5 lists Kathleen Hanna, Corin Tucker, Carrie Brownstein and Tobi Vail; p.8 has Ego Records contact.

review.decision_scope: local editorial selection for source-linked companion lists
review.summary: Personal mini-zine signed Jolie Ego, with music fandom, handwritten lists and collage. Suitable for the historical personal-zine shelf; not a movement manifesto.
review.content_evidence: PDF p.2 dates the issue 8-26-03 and explains the personal newsletter; p.5 lists Kathleen Hanna, Corin Tucker, Carrie Brownstein and Tobi Vail; p.8 has Ego Records contact.

priority_candidates.title: Flannel & Band Tees Issue # 2
